input.title: Send scheduled export emails in the recipient's locale
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In runScheduledExport, the call to scheduledExportEmail passes no locale, so the template's default "en" is used and the email is English whatever the profile language. fr.json already contains email.export.subject and email.export.body. Change the call to pass the locale of the report's owner (looked up from the user record, since the schedule stores only recipient addresses), so the French strings are used for French profiles. fr.json itself needs no change.

text:
Issue #4618 is triaged as a bug, and I opened draft pull request pr-23 against `src/export/scheduler.ts`.

The reporter thought `src/i18n/fr.json` was missing the scheduled export strings. It isn't: `email.export.subject` and `email.export.body` are already translated there. The real cause is in the scheduler. `runScheduledExport` calls `scheduledExportEmail` without a locale, so the template falls back to English whatever the owner's profile language is.

The pull request proposes passing the report owner's locale into that call. The schedule stores only recipient addresses, so the change also has to look up the owner's user record. `fr.json` needs no change.

I posted the comment (comment-28) after the label and the pull request, as the triage steps require.
